positiveControls: issue inserts the pending sender order and voucher in one transaction and rolls back a code collision
PostgreSQL redemption locks the paid voucher and inserts one recipient order in the same transaction
currency is checked against the current offering at selection and recipient address/tag is validated before the intended redemption call
riskFindings: The deployed redemption handler calls store.redeem without defining store in local or module scope, so the customer path fails before the atomic transition.
The paid gift-card sender is defined but has no call site, although customer and marketing copy promise a card after payment.

A six-character roughly 30-bit plaintext bearer code is disclosed in the pre-payment preview, never expires, has no bounded attempt ledger or redemption rate limit, is embedded in the sender order username, and is searchable/copyable in admin.
Distinct not-found, unpaid and redeemed responses expose a gift-code validity/state oracle without throttling.
Issue and redemption are money writers without persisted immutable gift intents, client idempotency keys, audit correlation IDs, immutable quote provenance or a redeemed_order_id binding.
Rate acquisition may use stale or hard-coded fallback values; handlers coerce missing calculations to zero and repository/schema boundaries accept caller-supplied zero rate or crypto amount.
Payment transition updates every pending voucher sharing an order_id, while the schema permits duplicate or null order bindings and has no foreign key or uniqueness constraint.
Redemption re-prices the RUB promise using the recipient commission and current cache, so the amount previewed to the sender is not an immutable delivery obligation.

Recipient-order creation commits before direct worker/admin notifications; notification failure has no gift-specific durable outbox or reconciliation, and broad admin text includes the full destination.
The public site and Mini App promote vouchers without a functional workflow or explicit Telegram handoff.
blockers: no durable paid-card or redemption notification delivery
no bearer-code expiry, digest storage, attempt throttling or least-privilege admin masking

independentReviews.scope: context-aware artifact, surface, hash, catalog and count review; not lifecycle acceptance
adversarial diff/security review; timestamped observation and static inventory tests do not reproduce production or exercise money writers
